findings.F1: Outside the falling agitated profile, a day that pierces the prior 30-day low and closes back above it is followed by a 5-day return 4.12 % below the coin's normal drift (113 cases, 75 days, t −1.98). Inside the profile the same situation is followed by +3.89 % (30 cases, 15 days, t 1.29). The sign of the brief's effect flips with the market.
findings.F2: Outside the profile, the fall after a reclaim is graded the wrong way for the tested idea. Reclaims whose close sits higher above the prior low, against the day's range, are followed by −5.57 % excess over 5 days (63 cases, 44 days, t −2.32), against −1.95 % for the lower half (60 cases, t −0.83). The Spearman correlation of that reclaim measure with the excess return is −0.196 on about 113 cases.
findings.F3: Outside the profile, the post-reclaim fall shows on most coins and years. The excess is negative on 4 of 6 coins over all reclaims (ETH −6.45 % with t −2.02, XRP −5.07 % with t −1.55). By year it is negative in 3 of 4 years (2018 −2.79 %, 2020 −12.89 % with t −1.87, 2021 −2.82 %; 2019 +0.28 %).
findings.F4: Split by the 30-day trend and the swing, the fall is largest in a choppy, agitated market. There, reclaims are followed by −7.74 % excess over 5 days (18 cases, 17 days, t −2.31), against −0.48 % in a choppy, calm market (26 cases) and −0.43 % in a falling, agitated one (57 cases).
findings.F5: Inside the profile, the gain does not come from reclaims. The largest one-day falls, the lowest quintile of the day's return over its 30-day swing, are followed by +3.22 % excess over 5 days (175 cases, 84 days, t 2.34). This is the falling-agitated fall rebound the map already holds (035-01, 047-01, 051-01, 038-01), so it is not a discovery.
findings.F6: A day that pierces the 30-day high and closes back below it, in a rising market, is followed by +3.22 % excess over 5 days (181 cases, 119 days, t 2.22). The top quintile of the 10-day return in a rising market gives +2.84 % (287 cases, t 2.80). Both repeat the rising-market continuation ideas the map already holds (033-03.b2, 034-01), so they are left out.
findings.F7: The book is small in its own measure. It is in a position on 2 % of coin-days, makes 0.0071 trades a day and earns +1.3 % a year. Its per-case total move of +1.93 % is 10 times the 0.19 % trade cost, so cost is not what holds it back. What holds it back is the uncertain size (t 0.76) and the rarity of cases.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, when a coin's day trades below its lowest price of the past 30 days but closes back above that low, the coin falls over the next 5 days, and the fall is larger the higher the close sits above that low, measured against the day's range.
ideas.consequence: Outside a falling market a reclaimed monthly low is a trap for buyers rather than a floor, so a trader should refuse the rebound long there and lean short, more so after a strong reclaim.
ideas.name: choppy reclaimed low falls
